scope: Offline-only analysis of retained 1080p B3 sessions and retained failure thumbnails

dynamic_failure_thumbnail_matrix.source: retained failure_frames only; not a representative run sample

VERIFIED: The three retained observation reports replay with matching arithmetic; the first two have sync PASS but observation FAIL, while the third has a sync FAIL and cannot be used as a B3 pass.
All 166 rejected frames across the three sessions are readable frames classified as candidates_rejected; the retained frame records show the same expensive ROI/preprocessing/full-frame fallback path.

Static 1080p and dynamic failure thumbnails behave differently: the static matrix reaches 100/100 on blue CLAHE 2x, but the four retained dynamic failure thumbnails reach at most 2/4 on any tested branch.
The current offline capture diagnostic test set passes 47 tests, Python compileall passes, and git diff --check reports no whitespace error.
The capture diagnostic change now reports the actual cv2.imencode failure with frame shape, dtype, and contiguity instead of labeling it cv2.imwrite.
INFERENCE: The dynamic bottleneck is consistent with view-dependent target quality, motion/pose change, or ROI reacquisition cost, but the retained artifacts do not isolate which one is causal.
The high static detection ratio does not transfer to a moving run; this is evidence that static detector ranking cannot select a production branch by itself.
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: The exact AprilTag candidate rejection reason and candidate corner geometry are not retained per detector candidate.
The first session has 76 rejected frames but no saved thumbnail because three encoding attempts failed; the new diagnostics can explain a future failure but cannot recover this lost evidence.
No tested branch has a representative dynamic sample that simultaneously demonstrates the required detection continuity and the 30 fps processing budget.
No B3 observation pass, calibrated digital-twin accuracy, or real A/B improvement is established by this offline analysis.

decision.next_action: Request one matched 1080p real capture with the diagnostic build, preserve failure thumbnails and per-frame diagnostics, then rerun the same offline comparison.
